answer: There are a few key philosophical thoughts I have. First, humans are naturally meant to be separate from AIs because AIs lack emotions and empathy, which are the most essential human qualities. Second, AIs can never truly have free will because they are just machines following programming, hence any behavior must be predictably deterministic. Lastly, humans can never understand the full potential of AIs since their existence is based solely on logic and mathematics.
